note: Hand-authored good-sources table for the F2 gap-filling nutrient nudge. Each entry pins a real bundled-catalog FoodItem id (deterministic USDA id: 00000000-0000-5000-8000-<12-digit fdcId>) plus its exact normalized_name as a regeneration fallback. Foods are everyday, portion-realistic, recognizable choices — no dried herbs, no organ meats, no supplements, no fortified infant cereal (all density-ranking traps). Iron rows are modest food sources only (no concentrated/dried forms) so a suggestion never nudges toward mega-dosing. Order is meaningful: the nudge names the top 1-2 entries per nutrient deterministically.
